run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch remained blocked by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), reconfirmed this run against www.tenders.gov.au despite the proxy status endpoint reporting healthy (bundleCoversEveryHost:true, no recent relay failures) - i.e. an organisation egress policy, not a transient fault. Consequently no tender detail page or specification document could be opened and every opportunity is captured at headline level from WebSearch result snippets only. Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals were probed via search. AusTender surfaced three genuinely new, currently-open Commonwealth opportunities not present in the routine's 470 known dedup keys: ATM_2026_3858 (Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry - Platform-software-as-a-service to automate registration, verification and monitoring of Offshore Treatment Provider (OTP) businesses; published 14 Sep 2026, closes 14 Oct 2026), RFT 02-2026 (Australian Federal Police - panel for medical services for pre-employment, pre/post-deployment for AFP appointees and dependants; published 2 Sep 2026, closes 8 Oct 2026), and DIG-ICD-IDT-01 (Department of Defence - ISG - classified industry briefing / market engagement for the Defence Intelligence Targeting Enterprise; updated 11 Sep 2026, closes 21 Sep 2026). Other AusTender ATMs returned by search were either already captured on prior runs (PRN9254, DPS26000961, CSIRORFT2026030, ASCA-RFT-2026-LDTPM, RFT-2026-0154, PR10031930-RASS, RFI_ATM_2026_6026) or already closed (EST10828 RAAF East Sale refurbishment closed 20 Jan 2026), so were not re-added. NSW (buy.nsw - only known TfNSW/Premier's Dept items resurfaced), VIC (Buying for Victoria - DOT45162 already known), QLD (QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au), WA (Tenders WA), SA (Tenders SA), TAS (Tenders Tasmania), NT (QTOL) and ACT returned only portal landing pages, generic aggregator results, or already-known opportunities with no NEW current opportunity surfaced via search this run. Tier 2 covered universities (UTS 'Connected Assessment Ecosystem' EOI surfaced only via a paid aggregator and could not be confirmed against UTS's own buyer source, so not captured; University of Adelaide items already known), GBE utilities (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, Transgrid - all already known or non-current) and public health - no NEW specific opportunity surfaced. Tier 3 was attempted per mandate (SAP Business Network Discovery / Ariba, BHP Find Opportunities): corporate opportunity detail is registration- or invitation-gated and none was publicly visible via search, so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only, never fabricated as tenders. DFAT AusConnect development-procurement EOIs seen this run (RFT26-005 submarine cable systems, RFT26-003 quality infrastructure) had already closed on 13 Sep 2026 and were not added. Source discovery remains saturating: every candidate source examined this run (DFAT AusConnect, GovPanels / suppliers.tenders.gov.au supplier portal, SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP Find Opportunities) was already in the known-source set of 337, so no genuinely new buyer-originated source was added - reported honestly rather than padded.
gaps: NETWORK EGRESS BLOCK (primary cause of a degraded run, consistent with recent prior runs): WebFetch to external hosts is denied by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), reconfirmed this run against www.tenders.gov.au. The agent proxy status endpoint reported healthy (enabled:true, bundleCoversEveryHost:true, recentRelayFailures empty) yet external host fetches are still policy-blocked, so this is an organisation egress policy, not a transient TLS/proxy fault; it was not retried or routed around per proxy guidance. Only WebSearch (US-based, via Anthropic) and the GitHub MCP were reachable.

Because no external detail page or specification document could be opened, deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/value/contacts could not be extracted for any of the three tenders; all entries are headline-level and pending a detail pass. Fields not present in search snippets are left null/"" rather than inferred.

RFT 02-2026 (AFP medical services): the AFP explicitly does NOT publish RFT information on AusTender - tenderers must sign an AFP Deed of Confidentiality and email AFP-RFT@afp.gov.au to receive the RFT documents via a secure link. Scope beyond the one-line summary, deliverables, evaluation criteria, value and panel structure could therefore not be read and are left null/empty.

DIG-ICD-IDT-01 (Defence Intelligence Targeting Enterprise): this is a classified industry-briefing / market-engagement notice, not an open RFT; attendance requires a minimum NV1 security clearance and the briefing content is classified, so no public deliverables/requirements exist to extract. Captured as procurement_type market-sounding at headline level.

Tier 1 states: AusTender and all state/territory portals could only be read through WebSearch snippets, not their live ATM/RFT lists, feeds or pagination, so full lists could not be swept. buy.nsw, QTenders (QLD), Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders returned only portal landing pages, generic aggregator results, or already-known opportunities (no NEW current opportunity surfaced this run).

Tier 2 universities: UTS 'Connected Assessment Ecosystem' EOI appeared only via a paid aggregator (australiantenders.com.au) and could not be confirmed on UTS's own buyer-originated procurement page via search; per the buyer-originated rule it was NOT captured as a tender and is noted here rather than fabricated.

Tier 3 SAP Business Network Discovery / Ariba and BHP Find Opportunities: no specific currently-open, publicly-visible Australian RFx could be confirmed via search (results were generic platform/how-to pages). Corporate opportunities are registration- or invitation-gated; recorded as portals in discovered_sources, not as tenders. Invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs remain out of scope and were not fabricated.

Source discovery is saturating: of every candidate source examined this run (DFAT AusConnect, GovPanels / suppliers.tenders.gov.au Commonwealth supplier portal, SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP Find Opportunities) all were already in the known-source set of 337. No genuinely new buyer-originated source was found this run; new_sources_found is reported honestly as 0 rather than fabricating one.
recommended_seed_additions: INFRASTRUCTURE NOTE (not a source): resolve the WebFetch/egress block. Every run for an extended period has been degraded to headline-level because external hosts are policy-blocked; an authenticated, unblocked run is required to extract deliverables, requirements, values, closing times, documents and contacts from the tenders' own detail pages and to read registration-gated Tier 3 corporate opportunities.

https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm?orderby=Close+Date - AusTender open-ATM list ordered by close date; when egress is unblocked, sweep this and follow pagination for full Tier 1 Commonwealth coverage instead of relying on WebSearch snippets.

tenders.title: Platform software as a service for Offshore Treatment Provider (OTP) registration, verification and monitoring
tenders.buyer: Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry
tenders.description: A Request for Tender by the Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry for a digital platform (platform-software-as-a-service) to automate and streamline the registration, verification and ongoing monitoring of Offshore Treatment Provider (OTP) businesses, supporting the department's international business verification function.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Provision of a platform-software-as-a-service solution that automates and streamlines the registration, verification and ongoing monitoring of Offshore Treatment Provider (OTP) businesses for the Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry. The detailed functional scope, integration, data and licensing requirements were not readable from the AusTender search snippet and the detail page could not be opened this run due to the egress block.
key_deliverables: A SaaS platform to register Offshore Treatment Provider (OTP) businesses
Automated verification of OTP businesses (international business verification)
Ongoing monitoring of registered OTP businesses
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of AusTender current ATMs. Buyer-originated Commonwealth listing published on AusTender by the Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry (the buying agency's own portal). Not present in the routine's 470 known dedup keys from prior runs.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only. Buyer, category (Platform software as a service), scope summary, publish date (14 Sep 2026) and closing (14 Oct 2026, 2:00 pm ACT local time) came from AusTender search-result snippets; the tender's own detail page and any specification documents could not be opened this run because external WebFetch is blocked by the environment egress proxy. Value, contract term, evaluation criteria, contacts and documents were not present in the snippets and are left null/empty rather than inferred. Pending a full detail pass on an unblocked run.

tenders.title: Medical services for pre-employment, pre and post deployment for AFP appointees and their dependants
tenders.description: A Request for Tender by the Australian Federal Police for the provision of medical services covering pre-employment, and pre- and post-deployment health for AFP appointees and their dependants, across all Australian states and territories. Appears to be a panel-style arrangement spanning multiple locations.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Supply of medical services - pre-employment screening and pre- and post-deployment medical assessments - for AFP appointees and their dependants nationally. The full scope, deliverables, panel structure, evaluation criteria and value are not published on AusTender: the AFP explicitly states it will NOT make RFT information available on AusTender, and tenderers must sign an AFP Deed of Confidentiality and email AFP-RFT@afp.gov.au to obtain the RFT documents via a secure link.
key_deliverables: Pre-employment medical services for AFP appointees
Pre-deployment medical services for AFP appointees and their dependants
Post-deployment medical services for AFP appointees and their dependants
tenders.submission_method: RFT documents released only after signing an AFP Deed of Confidentiality (email AFP-RFT@afp.gov.au); submission mechanics not published on AusTender.
mandatory_conditions: Tenderers must complete and sign an AFP Deed of Confidentiality and send it to the AFP Contact Officer to be given access to the procurement information / RFT documents
tenders.delivery_location: National - ACT, NSW, VIC, SA, WA, QLD, NT, TAS (Canberra, Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide, Perth, Brisbane, Darwin, Hobart)
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of AusTender current ATMs. Buyer-originated Commonwealth listing published on AusTender by the Australian Federal Police. Not present in the routine's 470 known dedup keys from prior runs.

Buyer, one-line scope, delivery locations, publish date (2 Sep 2026), closing (8 Oct 2026, 4:00 pm ACT local time) and the Deed-of-Confidentiality access mechanism came from AusTender search-result snippets; the AFP does not publish RFT detail on AusTender and the notice page could not be opened this run because external WebFetch is blocked by the environment egress proxy. tenders.title: Defence Intelligence Targeting Enterprise - classified industry briefing / market engagement
tenders.buyer: Department of Defence - Intelligence and Security Group (ISG)
tenders.description: A notice by the Department of Defence (Intelligence and Security Group) inviting industry to a classified briefing on the Defence Intelligence Targeting Enterprise and the Targeting Program that supports it (including Intelligence Mission Data (IMD) uplift). The briefing gives industry an overview of the Enterprise and where Defence considers industry could contribute; it is early market engagement rather than an open tender.
tenders.deliverables_summary: This is a market-engagement / classified industry-briefing notice, not an open RFT, so there are no supplier deliverables published. Defence will hold a classified briefing in Canberra in the week commencing 28 September 2026 to outline the Defence Targeting Enterprise, the supporting Targeting Program and related projects (e.g. Intelligence Mission Data uplift) and to indicate where industry could contribute.
requirements: Attendees must hold a minimum Negative Vetting 1 (NV1) security clearance (the briefing is classified)
tenders.eligibility: Industry participants able to hold a minimum NV1 security clearance
tenders.briefing: Classified industry briefing in Canberra, week commencing 28 September 2026; attendees require a minimum NV1 security clearance.
tenders.submission_method: Register interest via the AusTender notice (registrations to attend the classified briefing).
mandatory_conditions: Minimum Negative Vetting 1 (NV1) security clearance required to attend the classified briefing
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of AusTender current ATMs. Buyer-originated Commonwealth listing published on AusTender by the Department of Defence (Intelligence and Security Group). Not present in the routine's 470 known dedup keys from prior runs.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only, and by nature a classified market-engagement notice rather than an open RFT (no public deliverables).
